titleEn: Maximum Number of Achievable Transfer Requests
title: 最多可达成的换楼请求数目
summary: 每个请求让一名员工从一栋楼调到另一栋楼，选择最多请求使每栋楼净人数变化为零。
insight: 请求数最多十六，可枚举所有子集。对选中请求计算各楼净变化，全部为零时用子集位数更新答案。
pitfalls: 自环请求净变化为零且应尽量选择

solutions.title: 请求子集枚举
solutions.idea: 暴力验证每个请求选择集合的净流量。
steps: 枚举 mask，若 bitCount<=answer 可跳过
balance[n]=0；选中请求 from--、to++；若全部零更新 answer

code.java: class Solution { public int maximumRequests(int n,int[][] requests){int answer=0,total=1<<requests.length;for(int mask=0;mask<total;mask++){int selected=Integer.bitCount(mask);if(selected<=answer)continue;int[] balance=new int[n];for(int i=0;i<requests.length;i++)if((mask&(1<<i))!=0){balance[requests[i][0]]--;balance[requests[i][1]]++;}boolean valid=true;for(int value:balance)if(value!=0){valid=false;break;}if(valid)answer=selected;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maximumRequests(n:Int,requests:Array<IntArray>):Int{var answer=0;for(mask in 0 until (1 shl requests.size)){val selected=Integer.bitCount(mask);if(selected<=answer)continue;val balance=IntArray(n);for(i in requests.indices)if(mask and (1 shl i)!=0){balance[requests[i][0]]--;balance[requests[i][1]]++};if(balance.all{it==0})answer=selected};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maximumRequests(int n,vector<vector<int>>& requests){int answer=0,total=1<<requests.size();for(int mask=0;mask<total;++mask){int selected=__builtin_popcount((unsigned)mask);if(selected<=answer)continue;vector<int> balance(n);for(int i=0;i<(int)requests.size();++i)if(mask&(1<<i)){--balance[requests[i][0]];++balance[requests[i][1]];}if(all_of(balance.begin(),balance.end(),[](int value){return value==0;}))answer=selected;}return answer;} };
